name: Zola proposal-film Open Graph card by zola.com
description: A photography-only 1200×630 social card: a full-bleed, warm, film-like image of a garden proposal fills the entire canvas with no wordmark, headline or overlay. The composition does the branding work — the kneeling proposer and standing partner form a vertical focal axis slightly right of centre, framed by dark foliage on the left and soft white blossoms at the right edge for depth. Colour comes entirely from the scene: lush greens punctuated by a coral zigzag dress, with natural bokeh keeping edges soft. It reads as an editorial still rather than a marketing asset, letting the emotional moment carry recognition.
